releases.name: wizardingcode-mem 0.8.0
releases.body:
## Install

From inside your agent — see the [README](https://github.com/WizardingCode-io/wizardingcode-mem#install) for each one. For example:

```sh
claude plugin marketplace add WizardingCode-io/wizardingcode-plugins && claude plugin install wizardingcode-mem@wizardingcode-plugins
codex plugin marketplace add WizardingCode-io/wizardingcode-plugins && codex plugin add wizardingcode-mem@wizardingcode-plugins
```

The `wizardingcode-mem-*` files are the binaries the plugins fetch.

## Shared names

A project with no git remote can now be shared with a team. It is given a shared name (`name:<slug>`), created once on the team server and joined by the others, from the project's dock in the viewer or with `wizardingcode-mem share project <level> --as <name> --create`; a project with a remote keeps its remote as its name. `wizardingcode-mem share names` lists the server's names and `share name forget` lets a name go at Nothing. The server speaks contract 2 (the registry of names, `POST /v1/names`, `GET /v1/names`, `GET /v1/names/:alias`, `serve purge name <alias> --yes`), with contract 1 still accepted. The record is [ADR 0028](https://github.com/WizardingCode-io/wizardingcode-mem/blob/main/docs/adr/0028-shared-names.md).

## Upgrade

Upgrade the team server before the members: a 0.8.0 client against a 0.7.0 server holds its shared names (`wizardingcode-mem status` ends the server line `names held (server at contract 1)`) until the server speaks contract 2; everything else keeps flowing. The runbook's Upgrade section: set `WIZARDINGCODE_MEM_VERSION=0.8.0` in `.env`, then `docker compose pull server && docker compose up -d server`. The server copies `team.db` to `/data/backups/` and migrates in place (team schema 2).

On each machine the store moves to version 8 on the first open by 0.8.0, after a copy of the file is kept in the store folder's `backups/`. A 0.7.0 binary refuses a version 8 store: its hooks fail open and `wizardingcode-mem doctor` says so; nothing is deleted or withdrawn. To go back to 0.7.0, put that copy back in place of the store file.

## Changes

- Shared names: share a project without a git remote (ADR 0028) (#34)
- Perf budgets: the CI slack for the rebuild transaction and the semantic median (#36)
- Release 0.8.0 (#35)

releases.name: Model: potion-multilingual-128M (v1)
releases.body:
The optional model behind wizardingcode-mem's search by meaning (`wizardingcode-mem embed download`, or the Settings → Search card). Nothing downloads it unless you ask.

- `potion-multilingual-128M.wcpack`: [minishlab/potion-multilingual-128M](https://huggingface.co/minishlab/potion-multilingual-128M) at revision `73908c3438cf03b6a01bcb9611d62b23d0726f08`, repackaged unchanged for the TypeScript engine; `scripts/embed/pack.ts` rebuilds it byte for byte.
  sha256 `7d8362253e568e7bb24ff8be3f006f412973aa445a96c4c17b6f13a957825c6a`, 146,383,528 bytes.
- `LICENSE-potion.txt`: the model's MIT licence (Minish Lab).

The binary checks the size and the sha256 before using the file.
